prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Se alguém não quiser trabalhar, também não coma.

meta.face: An Irishman of about fifty-five with a fair, freckled, weather-browned complexion and a HEART-SHAPED face, BROAD at the temples and tapering to a NARROW chin — the front of the head shaved from ear to ear in the Irish tonsure, leaving a high, bare, lined forehead, with dark-brown hair greying and falling from behind the ears to the nape; a long, THIN nose with a KNOBBED, rounded tip, SMALL, bright, dark-grey eyes set CLOSE under SHAGGY dark brows, sharp, high cheekbones over lean cheeks, a small mouth; a SHORT, POINTED dark-brown beard streaked with grey; the gaze kindly and shrewd, toward us. Not the long, big-boned, jutting-chinned, red-grey columban, nor the broad, clean-shaven, white-haired columba.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the book tells an Irish anchorite who cleared his own garden at Breuil, and his emblem since the Middle Ages is the spade (as in the Bar-le-Duc window on Wikipedia). The face is ours, an Irish monk of the seventh century with the ear-to-ear tonsure.
